LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Crown.nodes.0.label: Crown Inheritance
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Crown.nodes.0.description: Advance while wearing the Demon Crown. Keeps its renown, contribution sharing and diminishing returns. Grants neither duplicate base stats nor extra renown. Progression stays with the item; unequipping stops its effects.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Crown.nodes.1.label: Changing Fronts
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Crown.nodes.1.description: Three counted ordinary hits, each on a different target from the previous counted hit and no more than 3 seconds apart, deal 50 bonus damage on the third hit, once per 8 seconds. Repeated hits on the same target neither add a count nor extend the window. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Crown.nodes.2.label: Oath of Shelter
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Crown.nodes.2.description: When your shield actually absorbs enemy damage, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. Requires a shield from another source. Does not heal you when no injured ally is available. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Crown.nodes.3.label: Echo of Conquest
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Crown.nodes.3.description: After Changing Fronts actually deals its bonus damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 8 seconds. Never hits the original target again. Base rewards: damage 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Crown.nodes.4.label: Breathing Room
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Crown.nodes.4.description: After Changing Fronts actually deals its bonus damage, heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Fully prevented bonus damage grants nothing. Does not restore permanent scars or missing parts. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Crown.nodes.5.label: Guarding Decree
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Crown.nodes.5.description: After Oath of Shelter actually heals an ally, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. The recipient may differ from the patient. Does not shield you instead. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Crown.nodes.6.label: Answering Blow
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Crown.nodes.6.description: After Oath of Shelter actually heals an ally, store one retaliation for 5 seconds, once per 8 seconds. A later ordinary hit consumes it for 75 bonus damage. Store at most one; healing itself deals no damage. Base rewards: damage 75.
